nc.description: Two mechanical hands hold a wedge-shaped object, guiding it through a ring toward a circular opening containing various geometric shapes.
A four-panel sequence displays a 3D-rendered mechanical linkage progressively engaging a rectangular block, culminating in a final frame where the block is replaced by a dark recess.
A light grey, untextured 3D model of an articulated mechanical component with a polygonal base and a hinged arm is displayed against a white background.
Several smooth, faceted, light-grey geometric objects, including a rod, a block, and wedge-like shapes, are arranged in close contact on a curved base.
A top-down view shows a stylized white model of an open-top car surrounded by a radiating arrangement of grey geometric shapes.

vc.description: A tool with grey handles is inserted into the opening of a grey, riveted structure containing small, spherical objects.
A light gray mechanical assembly features a gripping mechanism holding a cylindrical section, with a linked flanged cylinder positioned directly above a square receptacle.
A light gray, articulated mechanical arm is mounted on a base with suction cups.

Two grey mechanical assemblies, one featuring an articulated arm and a flat plate and the other a corrugated tube with a clamping lever, are positioned facing each other with a slight gap between them.
An assembled mechanical component is positioned in the center of a white surface, surrounded by an arrangement of its disassembled metal and plastic parts.
